faqs.question: Are multiple languages supported?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We support a wide range of languages including European and Brazilian Portuguese, US and UK English, Spanish (Spain & Mexico), French, and German. No more settling for apps that only support one dialect!

faqs.question: Do I need to know English to use this?
faqs.answer: Nope! Multi Lingo AI is powered by an engine that translates and explains concepts using ANY starting language or dialect you provide.

faqs.question: Can I talk to a real human?
faqs.answer: Yes! While our AI tutor is available 24/7, you can easily schedule live sessions with verified human tutors through our Smart Scheduler.

faqs.question: What makes Multi Lingo AI different?
faqs.answer: We focus on real, conversational languages with authentic slang and expressions. No textbook language here—just practical, everyday communication.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible pricing plans starting with a free tier. Premium plans unlock unlimited AI conversations and live tutor sessions.

faqs.question: Can I try it for free?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can use our free tier to explore all features. Most learners start with our free plan to see if Multi Lingo AI is right for them.

faqs.question: Is my learning data private?
faqs.answer: Yes! Your privacy is important to us. All conversation data is encrypted and you maintain full control over your learning information.

privacy.section1_text: Multi Lingo AI is an AI-powered language learning platform that helps you practice multiple languages and dialects from the dialects you already speak. Depending on where you live, applicable privacy laws such as the EU/EEA General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), UK GDPR, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and similar national laws may provide you with specific rights and protections. privacy.section2_1_text: When you create or manage an account we may collect: name, display name, and username; email address and password (for email/password login); profile image or photo URL; and authentication identifiers (e.g., Firebase UID, provider IDs from Google, Apple, Facebook, Twitter). For social logins, we receive information from the provider to authenticate you (such as an ID token) and may store limited profile data that the provider shares according to its own privacy policy.
privacy.section2_2_text: To provide language learning features, we may collect: language and dialect preferences; your progress in exercises, exams, and stories; words, phrases, and content you practice or generate; game/exercise performance, completion status, scores, and streaks; and settings you configure (interface language, notifications, learning goals, etc.).
privacy.section2_3_text: When you access the Service, we may automatically collect: device information (browser type and version, operating system, device identifiers); log data (IP address, timestamps, URLs, request metadata, error logs); and usage information (pages viewed, features used, interaction patterns). This information is used for security, debugging, analytics, and to improve the Service.
privacy.section2_4_text: If you purchase a subscription or other paid features, we and/or our payment processor may collect: payment method details (e.g., tokenized card information handled by a third-party processor such as Stripe); billing information (name, email, billing address if required); subscription status, plan type, renewal and cancellation dates; and transaction identifiers and basic metadata required for accounting and fraud prevention. We do not store full payment card numbers on our servers; these are handled by the payment provider in accordance with its own policies.
privacy.section2_5_text: If you contact us or interact with support, we may process: the content of your messages and inquiries; contact details such as email address and, if provided, phone number; and support logs, responses, and metadata.
privacy.section2_6_title: 2.6 Content and Audio Data for AI Features
privacy.section2_6_text: When you use AI-powered features, we may process: text you input (messages, prompts, corrections, translations); audio you upload or record for speech recognition or text-to-speech; and AI-generated outputs (translations, explanations, hints, feedback). Some of this content may be sent to third-party AI providers (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI, Perplexity AI, or similar vendors) to generate responses, speech, and other AI-driven features. Some speech playback may instead be generated locally by your device or browser's own text-to-speech engine, without any data being sent to us or an AI provider. We only send the minimum data required to provide the requested feature.
privacy.section2_7_text: We may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies to keep you logged in and maintain session state; remember your preferences (interface language, theme, etc.); measure usage patterns and performance; and support security and fraud prevention. You can control cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of the Service.
privacy.section3_1_title: 3.1 To Provide and Maintain the Service
privacy.section3_1_text: Creating and managing user accounts and profiles; delivering language learning content, exercises, exams, and progress tracking; providing AI-powered features such as translations, explanations, feedback, and speech; and enabling storage and retrieval of your content and files.
privacy.section3_2_text: Tailoring exercises and content to your level, interests, and dialect preferences; and adapting UI language, themes, and recommendations based on your settings and behavior.
privacy.section3_3_text: Sending transactional emails (account confirmation, password reset, subscription updates); responding to support requests and inquiries; and providing important notices about changes to the Service or this Privacy Policy.
privacy.section3_4_text: Monitoring performance and usage to understand how the Service is used; debugging issues and improving reliability; and developing new features and refining the learning experience. Where possible, we use aggregated or de-identified information for analytics.
privacy.section3_5_text: Authenticating users and preventing unauthorized access; detecting and responding to suspicious activity or abuse; and protecting our infrastructure, users, and intellectual property.
privacy.section3_6_text: If you are in the EEA or UK, we rely on the following legal bases: Contract — to provide the Service you requested (account creation, learning features, subscriptions); Legitimate interests — to secure and improve the Service, prevent fraud, and understand usage, balanced against your rights; Consent — where required by law for certain cookies/analytics or AI features that are not strictly necessary; and Legal obligation — to comply with tax, accounting, and other legal requirements.
privacy.section4_text: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it in limited ways with service providers (cloud hosting, databases, and storage such as Firebase/Google Cloud; authentication and identity management such as Firebase Auth; payment processing such as Stripe; email delivery and communication tools; AI engines and speech services such as Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Perplexity AI; and serverless hosting and edge deployment such as Vercel). These providers only receive the data necessary to perform their services and are bound by contractual confidentiality and security obligations. We may also disclose information if required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental request; to protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users or the public; or to investigate or prevent fraud, security incidents, or abuse of the Service. If we engage in a merger, acquisition, reorganization, or sale of assets, your data may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will take reasonable steps to ensure any successor respects this Privacy Policy or provides equivalent protections.
privacy.section5_text: Our company is incorporated in Wyoming, USA. Because we operate with cloud and AI providers located in multiple countries, your data may be processed outside your country of residence, including in countries that may have different data protection laws. Where required by law (e.g., for EEA/UK users), we implement appropriate safeguards for international transfers, such as standard contractual clauses (SCCs) or other legally recognized mechanisms, and we aim to work with providers that commit to robust security and privacy standards.
privacy.section6_text: We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide and improve the Service, maintain legal and accounting records, and resolve disputes and enforce agreements. In general: account and profile data are retained while your account is active; learning progress and content are retained to support your ongoing learning experience; and logs and technical data may be stored for shorter periods necessary for security and debugging. You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data, subject to legal obligations requiring us to retain certain records.
privacy.section7_text: Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights such as: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you; Rectification — ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data; Erasure — request deletion of your data, where permitted by law; Restriction — ask us to limit certain processing activities; Objection — object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing; Portability — receive your data in a structured, commonly used format; Withdraw consent — where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time; and CCPA (California residents) — you have the right to know, delete, and opt-out of the sale of personal information. We do not sell personal information. You can exercise some of these rights via your account settings; others require contacting us at the email address below. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling your request, and legal exceptions may apply.
privacy.section8_text: The Service is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under that age. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data without appropriate consent, please contact us so we can delete the data and, if necessary, close the account.
privacy.section9_text: We implement technical and organizational measures designed to protect your data, including Firebase Authentication with token-based access controls; signed URL authorization for storage operations; encrypted and secure communication protocols (HTTPS/TLS); CORS controls restricting API access to authorized origins; and regular monitoring and logging for suspicious activity. However, no online service is completely secure. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and notifying us of any suspected unauthorized access.
privacy.section10_text: The Service may integrate third-party services (e.g., payment processors, AI providers, social login providers) or include links to other websites. These third parties are responsible for their own privacy practices. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.
privacy.section11_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our Service, technology, or legal requirements. If we make material changes, we will notify you by updating the "Last updated" date and, where appropriate, through in-app notices or email. Your continued use of the Service after changes become effective means you accept the updated Privacy Policy.
privacy.section12_text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, you can contact us at grasshopper.it.solutions@gmail.com. Company: Grasshopper IT Solutions, LLC. Address: 1309 Coffeen Avenue STE 1200, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA. Service: Multi Lingo AI.
